scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run next:dist apps/web .next-main && bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run next:dist apps/landing .next-main && bun run --cwd apps/landing build
scripts.build:packages: bun run --cwd packages/db build && bun run --cwd packages/redis build && bun run --cwd packages/jobs build && bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/sdk build
scripts.dev: bun run next:dist apps/web .next-dev && bun run --cwd apps/web dev
scripts.dev:landing: bun run next:dist apps/landing .next-dev && bun run --cwd apps/landing dev -- -p 3000
scripts.dev:web: bun run next:dist apps/web .next-dev && bun run --cwd apps/web dev -- -p 3001
scripts.landing: bun run next:dist apps/landing .next-dev && bun run --cwd apps/landing dev
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:packages && bun run tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run tsc -p apps/workers/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run tsc -p apps/landing/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run tsc -p packages/jobs/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run tsc -p packages/redis/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/api test && bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd apps/workers test
